protocol: ISSUE71-COVERAGE-2026-11-02-01 plus preregistered offline terminal-width correction and width2 tree extension

policy_fidelity_audit.topology: conforms to issue71 minimum: anchor + two children + best grandchild under first child; parents0,0,1
policy_fidelity_audit.root_and_branch_choice: local stock score argmax/top2 and conditional successor, deterministic lower-rank tie break; not global joint optimization
policy_fidelity_audit.stock_numeric_path: actual BF16 head, top16 and predecessor/successor codebook edges/scores exported; all96 CPU reconstructions match stock select_logits
policy_fidelity_audit.future_access: constructors use pool IDs/scores only; capture persists policies before next teacher token; reference used afterward for evaluation
policy_fidelity_audit.anchor_alignment: anchor y[j] is already emitted and not consumed; future begins y[j+1]; accepted prefix plus one target bonus advances next cycle to j+L
policy_fidelity_audit.teacher_ring: same configured Q4/ring draft, production prefill helper, one-token true captured appends; KV bytes and offset unchanged across each group of three queries
policy_fidelity_audit.append_grouping_limit: probe does not independently prove bit equality of one-token teacher appends versus production commit-batched1..4token appends through affine4; canonical teacher-prefix coverage is measured, not every runtime chunk schedule
policy_fidelity_audit.width3_vs_width2: same depth2 topology recomputed offline from each actual captured width2 pool, not cropped from width3; no additional GPU execution
policy_fidelity_audit.tail_defect_corrected: initial simulator clipped full-width emissions instead of selecting width=min(nominal,remaining-1); current offline chain policy uses actual narrower pool, remaining1AR; trees use their width2/3 topology only for remaining>=4 and stock narrower-chain fallback otherwise
policy_fidelity_audit.broader_Weaver_limit: No trained path-conditioned draft, no width8 study, no actual target tree verifier; frontier heuristic is an offline allocation ablation only.
policy_fidelity_audit.frontier_extension: Three nodes chosen from best available local-logsoftmax prefix: stable binary64 exp/log over exported f32 scores, depth<=3, tie by depth then lexicographic rank path, ancestor-closed. Selection has no reference argument. Pairwise stock-score surrogate, not trained/full-path-conditioned Weaver or calibrated target acceptance.

bounded_model_check.symbolic_domain: Tree tokens/parents/len, four future u32 IDs, usize remaining budget, u32EOS; no assumptions
bounded_model_check.scope: actual pureRustcoverage bounds and singlebonus, not poolMLX numerics/cache/concurrency/tree execution

offline_replay.first_attempt: Assertion refused a history-label mismatch on HOLD tree tails: stock-chain versus tree-tail-stock-chain. All numerical fields were equal; label corrected before final success. No partial summary was written.
offline_replay.formal_scope: CrossHair unavailable; no symbolic proof of Python float/heap replay. Three deterministic shape cases and assertions over archived inputs. Rust Kani proof above remains limited to the original accounting helper.

decision: The fixed fork imposes a depth-two ceiling; frontier allocation addresses that limitation offline. This two-window coverage screen does not establish runtime speed, tree verification correctness or SSD cost, and cannot reject trained Weaver or tree decoding generally. Production B4 remains restored unchanged.
